subtitle: Operational configuration: environment variables and service lifecycle.

env.title: Environment variables
env.subtitle: Edit values that live in `~/.agim/.env`. Secrets are masked by default; toggle Reveal to see the full value.

service.title: Service
service.subtitle: Inspect the running agim process + start, stop, or restart it.

actions.confirmStopDesc: The web console, the messenger adapters, and any in-flight job will all stop. You'll need to start the service again before you can use it.
actions.confirmRestartDesc: The process stops and re-starts. In-flight jobs are cancelled; outbox + queued reminders survive the bounce. The web console will be unreachable for ~5-30 seconds.

admins.title: Admin allowlist
admins.subtitle: IM-side users who can run admin-tier commands (`/admin promote`, `/admin token`, etc.). The list lives in `IMHUB_ADMIN_USERS`; this editor only works when the agim web port is bound locally.
admins.notConfigured: Allowlist not configured — anyone with the CLI bootstrap token can self-promote.

remove.label: Remove
remove.confirmDescription: They lose access to all admin-tier commands. Re-add to restore.
